text.en: A RED TRAFFIC LIGHT MEANS
text.te: ఎరుపు రంగు (రెడ్) ట్రాఫిక్ సిగ్నల్ పడినప్పుడు ఏమిటి అర్ధం ?
text.hi: यातायात की लालबत्ती का मतलब

en: MUST STOP BEHIND WHITE STOP LINE
YOU MAY GO STRAIGHT IF NO TRAFFIC
YOU MAY TURN LEFT IF SAFE
SLOW DOWN AND PREPARE TO STOP
hi: ट्रैफिक न हो तो सीधे चले जाएं
सुरक्षित महसूस होने पर बाएं मुड़ें
यदि यातायात शुरू हो तो धीमे चलें

explanation.en: A red traffic light requires a complete stop behind the stop line. No movement is permitted until the signal turns green.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: MUST STOP BEHIND WHITE STOP LINE. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: MUST STOP BEHIND WHITE STOP LINE. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: A FLASHING YELLOW LIGHT INDICATES
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 2)

en: SLOW DOWN AND PROCEED WITH CAUTION
te: ఆప్షన్ 1: SLOW DOWN AND PROCEED WITH CAUTION
hi: विकल्प 1: SLOW DOWN AND PROCEED WITH CAUTION

explanation.en: A flashing amber/yellow signal indicates hazard. Slow down, check both directions, and proceed with caution.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: SLOW DOWN AND PROCEED WITH CAUTION. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: SLOW DOWN AND PROCEED WITH CAUTION. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: A FLASHING RED LIGHT INDICATES
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 3)

en: STOP, OBSERVE AND PROCEED WITH CAUTION
te: ఆప్షన్ 3: STOP, OBSERVE AND PROCEED WITH CAUTION
hi: विकल्प 3: STOP, OBSERVE AND PROCEED WITH CAUTION

explanation.en: A flashing red light acts like a STOP sign. Come to a complete standstill, ensure the intersection is clear, then proceed.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: STOP, OBSERVE AND PROCEED WITH CAUTION. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: STOP, OBSERVE AND PROCEED WITH CAUTION. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: THE SIGNS MARKED IN THIS OCTAGON ARE
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 4)

explanation.en: The 8-sided octagon STOP sign is mandatory. Every driver must bring their vehicle to a complete stop.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: STOP. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: STOP. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: THE SIGNS MARKED IN AN INVERTED TRIANGLE ARE
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 5)

explanation.en: An inverted equilateral triangle means GIVE WAY. Yield to circulating or cross traffic on the main road.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: GIVE WAY. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: GIVE WAY. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: THE SIGNS MARKED IN THIS CIRCLE ARE
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 6)

explanation.en: Circular signs with red borders are Mandatory (Regulatory) signs. Violating them is a penal offense.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: MANDATORY / REGULATORY. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: MANDATORY / REGULATORY. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: THE SIGNS MARKED IN THIS TRIANGLE ARE
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 7)

explanation.en: Triangular signs with red borders are Cautionary (Warning) signs that alert drivers to upcoming road hazards.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: CAUTIONARY / WARNING. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: CAUTIONARY / WARNING. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: THE SIGNS MARKED IN THIS RECTANGLE ARE
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 8)

explanation.en: Rectangular or square blue signs are Informatory signs that provide directions, distances, and facility locations.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: INFORMATORY. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: INFORMATORY. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: ON A ONE WAY ROAD, YOU REALISED THAT YOU ARE TRAVELLING AGAINST DIRECTION, YOU SHOULD
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 9)

en: CONTINUE TO THE END OF THE ROAD
te: ఆప్షన్ 1: REVERSE OUT OF THE ROAD
ఆప్షన్ 3: CONTINUE TO THE END OF THE ROAD
ఆప్షన్ 4: CONTINUE TO DRIVE IN REVERSE
hi: विकल्प 1: REVERSE OUT OF THE ROAD
विकल्प 3: CONTINUE TO THE END OF THE ROAD
विकल्प 4: CONTINUE TO DRIVE IN REVERSE

explanation.en: Never reverse on a one-way road. Safely continue to the road exit and turn onto a permitted route.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: CONTINUE TO THE END OF THE ROAD. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: CONTINUE TO THE END OF THE ROAD. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (ONE WAY)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 10)

en: ONE WAY (TRAFFIC FLOW PERMITTED IN ARROW DIRECTION)
te: ఆప్షన్ 1: ONE WAY (TRAFFIC FLOW PERMITTED IN ARROW DIRECTION)
hi: विकल्प 1: ONE WAY (TRAFFIC FLOW PERMITTED IN ARROW DIRECTION)

explanation.en: One-way street: Traffic movement is permitted only in the direction of the open arrow.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: ONE WAY (TRAFFIC FLOW PERMITTED IN ARROW DIRECTION). ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: ONE WAY (TRAFFIC FLOW PERMITTED IN ARROW DIRECTION). यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (ONE WAY OPPOSITE)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 11)

explanation.en: One-way street: Entry allowed only in the designated single direction.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: ONE WAY TRAFFIC ONLY. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: ONE WAY TRAFFIC ONLY. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (VEHICLES PROHIBITED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 12)

explanation.en: Both directions closed: No vehicles are permitted to enter or travel on this stretch.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: ALL MOTOR VEHICLES PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: ALL MOTOR VEHICLES PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (TRUCK PROHIBITED)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 13)

explanation.en: Commercial trucks and heavy goods vehicles are prohibited from entering this road.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: HEAVY GOODS VEHICLES PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: HEAVY GOODS VEHICLES PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (BULLOCK CART PROHIBITED)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 14)

explanation.en: Bullock carts and hand-driven animal carts are not allowed on this road.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: BULLOCK CARTS PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: BULLOCK CARTS PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (TONGA PROHIBITED)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 15)

explanation.en: Horse-drawn tongas are strictly prohibited on this road.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: TONGAS PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: TONGAS PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (HAND CART PROHIBITED)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 16)

explanation.en: Hand-pushed carts and wheelbarrows are prohibited from entering this road.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: HAND CARTS PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: HAND CARTS PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (CYCLE PROHIBITED)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 17)

explanation.en: Bicycles and pedal cycles are prohibited on this expressway/road.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: CYCLES PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: CYCLES PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (PEDESTRIANS PROHIBITED)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 18)

explanation.en: Pedestrians are prohibited from walking along or crossing this road (e.g. flyovers/highways).
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: PEDESTRIANS PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: PEDESTRIANS PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (RIGHT TURN PROHIBITED)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 19)

explanation.en: Turning right at this intersection is prohibited.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: RIGHT TURN PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: RIGHT TURN PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (LEFT TURN PROHIBITED)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 20)

explanation.en: Turning left at this intersection is prohibited.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: LEFT TURN PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: LEFT TURN PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (U-TURN PROHIBITED)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 21)

explanation.en: Making a U-turn (180-degree turn) is strictly forbidden.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: U-TURN PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: U-TURN PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (OVERTAKING PROHIBITED)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 22)

explanation.en: Overtaking any moving vehicle is strictly prohibited on this road segment.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: OVERTAKING PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: OVERTAKING PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (HORN PROHIBITED)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 23)

explanation.en: Sounding horn is forbidden. Commonly placed near hospitals, courts, and schools (silence zones).
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: HORN PROHIBITED (SILENCE ZONE). ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: HORN PROHIBITED (SILENCE ZONE). यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (NO PARKING)
text.hi: इस चिन्ह का मतलब (नो पार्किंग)

en: NO PARKING (WAITING ALLOWED TO DROP PASSENGERS)
hi: नो पार्किंग (सवारी उतारने हेतु क्षणिक रुकावट मान्य)

explanation.en: Blue circle with 1 red diagonal line: Parking is prohibited. Picking up or dropping passengers is permitted.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: NO PARKING (WAITING ALLOWED TO DROP PASSENGERS). ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: NO PARKING (WAITING ALLOWED TO DROP PASSENGERS). यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (NO STOPPING OR STANDING)
text.te: ఈ చిహ్నం అర్థమేమిటి ? (నో స్టాపింగ్ లేదా స్టాండింగ్)
text.hi: इस चिन्ह का मतलब (नो स्टॉपिंग)

te: నో స్టాపింగ్ లేదా స్టాండింగ్ (వాహనం అస్సలు ఆపరాదు)
hi: रुकना व ठहरना सख्त मना है

explanation.en: Blue circle with crossed red 'X': Neither stopping nor parking is permitted for any reason.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: NO STOPPING OR STANDING (CLEARWAY). ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: NO STOPPING OR STANDING (CLEARWAY). यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (SPEED LIMIT 50)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 26)

te: ఆప్షన్ 3: DISTANCE TO NEXT TOWN 50 KM
hi: विकल्प 3: DISTANCE TO NEXT TOWN 50 KM

explanation.en: Maximum permissible vehicular speed is 50 km/h.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: MAXIMUM SPEED LIMIT 50 KM/H. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: MAXIMUM SPEED LIMIT 50 KM/H. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (WIDTH LIMIT 2M)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 27)

te: ఆప్షన్ 1: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 2 METRES WIDTH PROHIBITED
hi: विकल्प 1: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 2 METRES WIDTH PROHIBITED

explanation.en: Vehicles wider than 2.0 metres cannot enter due to road or bridge width constraints.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 2 METRES WIDTH PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 2 METRES WIDTH PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (HEIGHT LIMIT 3.5M)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 28)

te: ఆప్షన్ 1: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 3.5 METRES HEIGHT PROHIBITED
hi: विकल्प 1: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 3.5 METRES HEIGHT PROHIBITED

explanation.en: Overhead clearance restriction (e.g. underpass or low railway bridge) of 3.5 metres.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 3.5 METRES HEIGHT PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 3.5 METRES HEIGHT PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (LENGTH LIMIT 10M)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 29)

te: ఆప్షన్ 1: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 10 METRES LENGTH PROHIBITED
hi: विकल्प 1: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 10 METRES LENGTH PROHIBITED

explanation.en: Long vehicles (buses/articulated trucks) over 10m cannot negotiate sharp bends ahead.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 10 METRES LENGTH PROHIBITED. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: VEHICLES EXCEEDING 10 METRES LENGTH PROHIBITED. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (LOAD LIMIT 5T)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 30)

en: MAXIMUM GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT LIMIT 5 TONNES
te: ఆప్షన్ 1: MAXIMUM GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT LIMIT 5 TONNES
hi: विकल्प 1: MAXIMUM GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT LIMIT 5 TONNES

explanation.en: Vehicles whose laden weight exceeds 5 tonnes cannot pass over this bridge or road.

explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: CATTLE / ANIMAL CROSSING AHEAD. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

te: ఆప్షన్ 1: PARKING LOT FOR TWO WHEELERS ONLY
hi: विकल्प 1: PARKING LOT FOR TWO WHEELERS ONLY

explanation.en: Designated parking space reserved exclusively for scooters and motorcycles.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: PARKING LOT FOR TWO WHEELERS ONLY. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: PARKING LOT FOR TWO WHEELERS ONLY. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: WHAT DOES THIS SIGN MEAN? (CYCLE PARKING)
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 93)

explanation.en: Designated stand for parking pedal bicycles.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: PARKING FOR BICYCLES (CYCLES) ONLY. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: PARKING FOR BICYCLES (CYCLES) ONLY. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।

text.en: TWO SOLID YELLOW LINES ON THE ROADWAY MEAN
text.hi: इस सड़क चिन्ह का क्या अर्थ है? (प्रश्न 94)

en: YOU MUST NOT CROSS THESE LINES TO OVERTAKE OR MAKE A U-TURN
te: ఆప్షన్ 1: YOU MUST NOT CROSS THESE LINES TO OVERTAKE OR MAKE A U-TURN
ఆప్షన్ 3: CAN CHANGE LANE WITH CAUTION
hi: विकल्प 1: YOU MUST NOT CROSS THESE LINES TO OVERTAKE OR MAKE A U-TURN
विकल्प 3: CAN CHANGE LANE WITH CAUTION

explanation.en: Double solid yellow lines prohibit crossing under all circumstances; acts like a physical barrier.
explanation.te: సరైన సమాధానం: YOU MUST NOT CROSS THESE LINES TO OVERTAKE OR MAKE A U-TURN. ఇది అధికారిక ట్రాఫిక్ నిబంధన.
explanation.hi: सही उत्तर: YOU MUST NOT CROSS THESE LINES TO OVERTAKE OR MAKE A U-TURN. यह आधिकारिक यातायात नियम है।
